name: Fall Fling
source:
A heartfelt visual novel about a messy bitch who lives for drama harassing her friends into dating each other. Contains an abundance of WLW, young love, old flames, several gremlins (do not feed after midnight), tiny pumpkins, hot moms, and at least one (1) werewolf.

[From [url=https://yurigods.itch.io/fall-fling]itch.io[/url]]
